project.community_frameworks: Free, prior, and informed consent (FPIC) obtained from Giriama and Digo communities. Grievance redress mechanism established. Benefit-sharing agreement signed with three local cooperatives covering 640 community members.
project.project_governance_structure: Project governed by a joint steering committee comprising Blue Carbon Kenya Ltd, two elected community representatives, and the Kenya Forest Service. Decisions require 75% approval. Annual external audit of governance processes.
project.public_comment_summary: 30-day public comment period held November 2022. Fifteen submissions received; key concerns related to fishing access rights and benefit distribution were addressed in the revised project design document.

organization.organization_mission: To restore and protect coastal blue carbon ecosystems across East Africa, delivering verified carbon credits alongside biodiversity and livelihood co-benefits.
organization.organization_team_experience: Leadership team combines 20+ years of blue carbon science, MRV, and community development. Previously developed three certified mangrove projects in Mozambique and Tanzania totaling 3,800 ha.
